m: कुच् cl. 1. P. कोचति, to sound high, utter a shrill cry (as a bird), Dhātup.; to polish, ib.; to go, ib. vii, 2; to connect, mix, ib.; to bend, make curved, ib.; to be curved or crooked, ib.; to oppose, impede, ib. : to mark with lines, write, ib. xx, 27 : cl. 6. P. कुचति, to contract, Dhātup. xxviii, 75; to be or make small, ib. vii, 3 (cf. √ कुञ्च्.)
a: कुच् — {vI.v} {c6c} P. (कुचति, कुचित) 1 To utter a shrill cry (as a bird). --2 To go. --3 To polish. --4 To contract, bend. --5 To be contracted. --6 To stop, impede. --7 To write or delineate. --8 To mix, connect. {vII.v} {c1c} P., कुंच् also (कोचति, कुंचति, कुंचित) 1 To make crooked, bend or curve. --2 To move or go crookedly. --3 To make small, lessen. --4 To shrink, contract. --5 To go to or towards.
